info.title: How to play
info.connections.heading: Connections
info.connections.body:
You get 16 words shuffled at random. Your job is to sort them into 4 groups of 4.

There is only one correct grouping. A word may look like it fits two categories — that's the trap; if you group wrong, another category will be short or over-full.

Pick 4 words you think belong together and submit. If wrong, try again. Depending on the puzzle, you'll have 4 mistakes or unlimited tries.

Groups are color-coded from easiest to hardest. Harder groups have subtler connections — you might miss them at a glance, but there's always a link.
